summary: Every requirement has delivering work I can point at: R1/R2 and the full-match ruling in PA's gate (Jenkinsfile.iac-image:28-56, input set re-verified against the Dockerfile's seven COPYs — nothing unwatched), R3/R5 in PB (28 prefixed commits plus the repoint to {{ playbook_dir }}/../../support/iac-agent), R4's in-tree drift in PC (grep modern-app-dev returns nothing; the README's five bind-mounts and six iac-controller jobs check out against the working tree). The three ACs no code phase owns are owned by the driver's own post-consult phases, not unassigned: V11's parity hand-back is the test phase's deploy-owed close-out (docs/slice-testing-strategy.md:63-75, command already recorded in PB's done-record and --limit iac_agent is a real inventory group), and V13 plus the outside-tree prose PB/PC explicitly deferred (role README, iac-agent runbook, the architecture nudge) are the doc phase's charter. The held-out lines are held out on purpose and verified so: both --limit "!iac_agent" exclusions intact, .kubecoder/config.yaml and Ansible.code-workspace still declaring IaCAgent, all four N4 duplicate files unchanged beyond the one docstring line V15 permits. Mechanical residue fixed in-session and committed (Ansible d1005fa, AnsibleSpecs cee6c05): bin/iac-impl:6 cited an openbao.md section anchor that file no longer has, Jenkinsfile.iac-image's empty-changeset comment claimed such a build is always the poller's when a hand-started build with no new commits takes the same branch, and PC's done-record still described the pre-fix install.sh hint; kc project lint is green over the result. What is left is advisory or needs an operator ruling, so it is carded rather than absorbed.
cards: verification.json has no criterion covering Jenkinsfile.iac-image:37-39, the empty-changeset branch that keeps the version poller's weekly rebuild building — the one piece of PA's gate the test phase has nothing to check off (PA reviewer r2, advisory).

PA's poller fix infers 'the poller triggered' from an empty changeset, so a poller-triggered build that happens to absorb commits touching no image input is still skipped, and per the poller's bookkeeping that weekly rebuild is never retried. Narrower than the r1 blocker but the same failure mode; closing it needs an operator ruling, since the 'no escape hatch' ruling weighed manual forcing, not the poller.

tools/ai_workflow/send_message.py:6 still cites /work/IaCAgent/bin/send_message.py as its source; that file now lives in-repo at support/iac-agent/bin/send_message.py. Left untouched on purpose — N4/V15 hold all four duplicate files move-only, and V15 names the single content change allowed — so correcting the provenance pointer is the operator's call.
